page_new.excerpt: # Multitenant isolation **Owning question:** How are tenant data and effects kept separate across every access path? Tenant isolation is a property of every query, cache key, queue consumer and credential, not a deployment label. The tenant scope must come from authenticated context and be enforced centrally. OWASP REST guidance treats object-level authorization as part of access control; it does not prescribe this isolation design. > **Pattern atlas:** > [Multitenant Isolation](../../v11-pattern-atlas/c11-security-operations/multitenant-isolation.md#multitenant-isolation) — decision conditions and contraindications. > [Tenant-Based Resource Isolation](../../v11-pattern-atlas/c09-scalability
